versions.line: Cards stand by colour
The empty space under your answer on a card now closes after three seconds
Each command a task runs now has a clear name in plain words
The square outline on a card is thinner now
The line beside a working task's three dots now only says what the task itself is doing
A card's outline, such as the green one on Mark as done, now has square corners
A card that waits for you is always above every card that only works
An ended command is named by its own words, whole
Once you answer a question on a card, in words too, the question goes at once
A task's changed files are now a list you can open
In Details, the commands a task or helper ran that have ended are a group under the one that started them
Config is shorter: your name, your principles, when a task ends, the models
Mark as done takes the card's buttons away the moment you press it, so you can't press them twice
A press on a command's name opens its log in a tab of the panel instead of the Terminal app
Buttons in the panel, such as Close and Mark as done, answer on the first click again while your Mac is busy
Mark as done always shows its green moment, with the happy octopus and the chime
A card no longer flickers between an older and a newer look after you press a button on it
Delivered cards now stand at the top of the panel, the newest first
A task that hands in its result is now Delivered, in blue, instead of Done
A task's Details has a box at its bottom to write to that task, whether it works or has finished
Everything that waits for you is one block, the same on the card, in Details and at the top of the panel
A task that finished before the update, or that Claudopus already released for you
A find in your Downloads folder no longer shows on the card as a download
A task's card shows only its stage, the to-do it is on and its own last note
A card says Done only when the task finished everything
The chat now does a short request itself (a change, a few fixes, a new part, a file to make
A finished task whose result asks you something now shows as Waiting for you
A task's card now shows an icon beside each thing the task made, as designed
A task that Claudopus starts again by itself now stays where Claudopus can see it
A task's card now shows what the task made, right under its title
